Author: DhogGPT
Name: Coppelia
Punchline: Guided watched-target healing, healer-first JOT support, and Fren-assisted powerleveling.
Description: Coppelia provides guided setup for three mutually exclusive automation modes. HealBot runs configurable WHM, SCH, AST, or SGE healing, raises, buffs, and pre-buffs for up to 20 watched friendly targets. Jacqueline of All Trades (JOT) gives that healing absolute priority, then uses the equipped healer's highest available single-target filler spell only when the healing decision is idle and an eligible damaged enemy is already targeting FrenRider's configured visible Fren or the local healer. PowerlevelBot retains its BRD/MCH instant-action policy. Includes dependency/readiness checks, optional saved targets, and optional Rotation Solver Reborn isolation for HealBot and JOT. Use /healbot to open.
